warnings: Day 12: BOOKED HSR G5 北京南→上海虹桥 07:59-12:32 (Jade only). Matilde travels Xi'an → Shanghai separately on her own routing.
Day 12: Pre-departure metro 五道口→北京南 07:15-07:50 (Line 13 → transfer). Leave home by 07:15.
Day 12: Breakfast is on-train G5 dining car (高铁G5车厢早餐), approx 30 CNY. No Shanghai sit-down breakfast — train departs 07:59.
Day 12: Taxi 上海虹桥→珍宝酒店 (汉口路678号) approx 50-55 min. Hongqiao is ~18km from People's Square via Yan'an Elevated Road.
Day 12: Lunch at 裕兴记蟹黄面馆(人民广场店) — walking distance from hotel (~5 min walk). Slot 13:30-14:30 fits within lunch window.
Day 12: Hotel check-in 珍宝酒店 14:30-15:00 (standard check-in 14:00). Brief check-in before heading to French Concession.
Day 12: Taxi hotel→马勒别墅 (陕西南路30号, Jing'an) approx 20 min, ~25-30 CNY.
Day 12: 法租界 heritage walk 15:20-17:30 — Moller Villa (马勒别墅) → Huaihai Middle Road (淮海中路) → Wukang Road (武康路). Combined with 武康路/安福路 boutique stroll. 2h10min walking at leisurely pace.

Day 12: GEOGRAPHIC FLOW OPTIMIZED — Dinner 吉士酒家(天平路) at 18:00 BEFORE 外滩 walk. Tianping Road (天平路) is ~500m walk from 武康路/安福路 area. This avoids backtracking from Bund back to French Concession. Flow: 武康路→吉士酒家(天平路)→外滩→hotel.
Day 12: Dinner at 吉士酒家(天平路41号) 18:00-19:30. Opens 17:00. Book ahead — fills quickly. 天平路41号 is ~500m walk from 武康路 endpoint.
Day 12: Taxi 吉士酒家(天平路)→外滩 approx 20 min, ~30-35 CNY. Distance ~8km east.
Day 12: 外滩+南京东路 evening walk 19:50-21:30. May sunset ~19:00, blue-hour lighting from 19:50 onward still excellent. Walk hotel doorstep east 8 min to 外滩 promenade.
Day 12: Wukang Road and Huaihai-Wukang heritage walk are combined in the same 15:20-17:30 slot — both activities share the French Concession area and are overlapping geographically.

Day 12: Peace Hotel Jazz Bar (optional entertainment) removed from primary flow — no time slot available after revised geographic-optimized sequence. Can be added if staying late after 外滩 walk (~21:45+).
Day 12: Return to hotel 珍宝酒店 is ~10 min walk from 外滩 promenade. End time 21:45.

warnings: Day 13: CRITICAL — G26 上海虹桥→北京南 departs 17:00 BOOKED (both passengers). Must reach Hongqiao by 16:10 at latest for boarding.

Day 13: Hotel check-out 珍宝酒店 09:00-09:30. Store large luggage at hotel or take with taxi to 虹桥. Recommended: collect luggage with taxi departing 珍宝酒店 at 09:30 and store at 虹桥 coin lockers, OR store at hotel and collect at 15:30 en-route to 虹桥.
Day 13: Breakfast at 春园·四如春(重庆南路183号) 07:30-08:30 — taxi back to hotel ~20 min. Opens 06:30.
Day 13: 豫园 opens 09:00. Arrive ~09:45 (after check-out). Book tickets online in advance via WeChat mini-program (40 CNY). Crowd builds fast after 10:00.
Day 13: 人和馆 lunch 12:00-13:30 — select branch near 豫园 (黄浦区人民广场/豫园区域). Opens 11:00. Reservations recommended.
Day 13: Taxi 豫园/人和馆 → 静安寺 approx 25-30 min (~9km west). Depart by 13:30.
Day 13: 静安寺 hours 07:30-17:00. Visit 14:00-15:30 comfortably within hours. Admission 50 CNY.
Day 13: Taxi 静安寺→虹桥 approx 35-40 min (~16km). Allow 40 min. Depart 15:30 to arrive 16:10.

Day 13: LUGGAGE NOTE — Simplest logistics: store large bags at 珍宝酒店 after check-out, collect en-route to 虹桥 with taxi at 15:30 (minor detour +10 min). Alternatively store in 虹桥 station lockers if going there directly.
Day 13: Accommodation destination is 五道口自如寓 (Beijing) — arrival after G26 at 21:32 北京南站, metro Line 4 → Line 13 Wudaokou ~43 min.
Day 13: HOMES上海本帮菜 dinner (primary) not feasible — both travelers on G26 by 17:00. Dinner replaced with G26 dining car (19:00-20:00 on-train).
Day 13: 新天地 shopping removed — no time available between 人和馆 lunch (ends 13:30) and G26 deadline (depart 静安寺 15:30).
Day 13: Taxi from 静安寺 to 虹桥 may take 40-50 min during afternoon traffic (15:30 departs — moderate congestion). Pre-book Didi in advance.
